messages:
alex: Heads up — CI red on merge of feature/kv-opt. Pre-commit hooks failing (mypy + eslint + rustfmt). Anyone else see this? :grimacing:
sana: seeing it too. Quick glance shows mypy errors in python client stubs.
ci-bot: Build 2234567890 failed on job: precommit-checks (mypy, eslint, rustfmt). Logs: https://ci.internal/2234567890
jamal: can you paste the mypy error snippet?
alex: sure — short log below:
```
client/python/redwood/client.py:42: error: "Optional[str]" has no attribute "strip"  [attr-defined]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 120 source files)
```
sana: hmm that's from a change in feature branch where header may be None. I can push a quick guard.
maria: before patching, can we reproduce locally? `./dev tools precommit --fast` ?
jamal: also eslint is failing in webapp: `src/components/Editor.tsx: Unexpected any` — maybe tsconfig loosened.
alex: I'm going to run a quick bisect to find the commit that introduced the precommit regression. If you need to unblock, create a hotfix branch and patch the None guard — should be safe.
sana: thanks — testing a fix now, will push if green.
ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex on job precommit-checks. Rerun queued.
maria: FYI, rustfmt diff in runtime/os/pack.rs — looks like new toolchain default changed fmt rules. Might need to pin rustfmt version in CI or run `cargo fmt --bless` in PR.
jamal: if bisect finds the PR that updated deps, we can revert quickly. Ping me if you want a quick revert.
sana: pushed fix: `fix(mypy): guard None in client header`. Running precommit locally...
sana: local precommit green, pushing to PR now. :rocket:
alex: thanks — will kick off CI and follow up if anything else fails.
ci-bot: Build 2234567890 rerun completed: success — precommit-checks passed.
alex: great — marking as resolved. Thanks all. :tada:
